messages:
jordan (Cust SRE): Hey team — AcroBank on-prem HSM backup job failing. Job id 20260316-2201. Put to S3 returns AccessDenied, so backups aren't landing and restores are blocked. Need urgent help, compliance window tomorrow.

ana (Support): Thanks Jordan — can you paste the exact error text and which IAM role/profile the backup agent is using?

jordan (Cust SRE): Log excerpt:
ERROR BackupRunner: Upload failed: AccessDenied: PutObject
StatusCode: 403 RequestId: 5A1F...
WrappedKey: kms:alias/acrobank-backup-key
HSM log: BACKUP_START id=20260316-2201, BACKUP_FAIL id=20260316-2201 (no BACKUP_COMPLETE entry)
Backup role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acro-hsm-backup-role
Bucket: s3://acrobank-hsm-backups

backup-bot: [alert] backup-job 20260316-2201 failed — reason AccessDenied — ticket SUP-8921 created

ana (Support): Can you run a repro from the backup host? 1) aws sts get-caller-identity using the assumed role 2) aws s3api put-object --bucket acrobank-hsm-backups --key test.txt --body /dev/null --server-side-encryption aws:kms --ssekms-key-id alias/acrobank-backup-key --profile backup-role  (paste output)

jordan (Cust SRE): Ran tests — sts shows assumed role arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/acro-hsm-backup-role/backup-agent. Put-object fails with 403. CloudTrail shows: KMS "AccessDenied" for kms:GenerateDataKey for principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/acro-hsm-backup-role/backup-agent. IAM role has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::acrobank-hsm-backups/*, so looks like KMS key policy/permission.

maya (Eng Security): Confirmed from CloudTrail: kms:GenerateDataKey failed. Current key policy allows kms:GenerateDataKey for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acro-hsm-kms-access and the account root, but NOT the backup role principal. Two options: (A) add the backup role to the key policy, or (B) create a KMS grant for the role at backup time. Grants are safer for temporary access.

ash (Infra Oncall): Quick network check — sometimes S3 403s happen when VPC endpoint policy or proxy strips auth headers, but here CloudTrail shows explicit KMS deny so key policy is the primary suspect. I'll validate VPC endpoint policy and NAT path while security fixes policy.

raj (Product Ops): Customer also flagged missing audit entries. Jordan, can you confirm HSM audit shows start and fail only? Also what's the retention for audit logs — customer is concerned about missing history.

jordan (Cust SRE): hsmctl logs show BACKUP_START and BACKUP_FAIL only. No BACKUP_COMPLETE. Audit ingestion pipeline also dropped some events around 22:03 due to a separate lambda write-permission error — I'm opening SUP-8922 for ingestion retries. Audit retention for the customer is 90 days, so we still have raw logs, but ingestion gap must be filled.

ana (Support): Proposed next steps:
1) Short-term workaround: create a KMS grant for the backup role so GenerateDataKey is allowed. Example command:
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/acrobank-backup-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acro-hsm-backup-role --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --name backup-grant
2) Re-run the backup job; confirm HSM emits BACKUP_COMPLETE and S3 object exists.
3) Long-term: eng-security to update the key policy to include backup role or implement an automated grant in the backup orchestration flow. eng-infra to verify endpoint/policy doesn't interfere. product to coordinate audit backfill and customer comms. Mark SUP-8921 P1.

maya (Eng Security): I'll draft the key policy change and review with infra for cross-account implications. If they prefer grants, we should automate grant creation/deletion via the job runner.

ash (Infra Oncall): I'll check VPC endpoint policy and run a manual put-object via the same subnet to rule out endpoint stripping. Posting results in 15m.

jordan (Cust SRE): Manual fix: created grant (used the create-grant command). Manual aws s3api put-object now succeeds. Re-ran backup job 20260316-2201 -> HSM log shows BACKUP_COMPLETE and S3 now has object s3://acrobank-hsm-backups/20260316-2201.enc. Customer kicked off restore test and it started.

ana (Support): Great — updating ticket SUP-8921: workaround applied and validated. Root cause: KMS key policy did not permit the backup role or a grant. Follow-ups: eng-security will make policy/grant change permanent or add automation (ETA 48h), infra to confirm VPC endpoint policy, product to handle audit ingestion backfill (SUP-8922).

maya (Eng Security): I'll push policy draft to the repo and tag infra for review. Also adding audit logging requirements to the incident doc so we can prove compliance.

ash (Infra Oncall): Endpoint policy looks fine; no proxy stripping detected. Confirming nothing else blocked on network side.

raj (Product Ops): I'll notify AcroBank that a restore test is in progress and we'll follow up once ingestion backfill completes.

jordan (Cust SRE): Customer confirmed restore started successfully. Will monitor and report if any further issues.

ana (Support): Closing loop for the immediate outage — marking as mitigated. Will keep SUP-8921 open until policy automation and audit backfill are complete. :white_check_mark:
